headline: Cunha Late, test2 Not Waiting
deck: Cunha's last-minute equaliser for Man Utd hands test2 a return, though his week up top stayed thin
body:
Cunha found it at the death for Manchester United, and test2 take a forward return from a fixture that had given them nothing to hold. It is the sort of point that arrives after the ledger looks closed, when a manager has already made peace with the blank.

That it lands late is little comfort against the shape of test2's week up front. The return steadies Cunha's line; it does not repair the pairing that has run two apart all week. What is known is the goal and the return. Everything beyond that test2 will wait for.
